title: File:ReceiptSwiss.jpg
note: German, but "Chässpätzli" is Swiss German for cheese spätzle. Prices in CHF, VAT at 7.6% (Switzerland's rate in 2007) and a euro conversion for tourists. The hotel sits on a mountain pass under the Wetterhorn, two hours' walk above Grindelwald.

title: File:KFC Xitun Carrefour Restaurant e-invoice ED64052745.jpg

answer.place: KFC, Carrefour Xitun, Taiwan Boulevard, Taichung

note: Traditional Chinese characters (not the simplified ones used in mainland China) and the date "109年": year 109 of the Republic of China calendar, used only in Taiwan (it's 2020). The "電子發票" e-invoice with a lottery number is a Taiwanese institution, and the store code starts TWI.

title: File:Alves receipt (2019) 01.jpg
note: Prices in FL, the Netherlands Antillean guilder, which only Curaçao and Sint Maarten still use. English item names, a US-style date, 6% sales tax, and the sign-off "Masha danki pa bo kompra!": Papiamentu for "thank you for your purchase".

title: File:GRC — Region Südliche Ägäis — Regionalbezirk Rhodos — Gemeinde Rhodos — Ialyssos-Ixia — 1 Iliadon Str. (Dionysos Hotel · Quittung für die Zahlung der Übernachtungstaxe) Mattes 2022-10-05.jpg

answer.place: Dionysos Hotel, Iliadon St, Ixia, Rhodes

note: Greek letters with English underneath: a receipt for the per-night accommodation tax Greek hotels charge. Ixia is the hotel strip on the west coast of Rhodes, the island closest to Turkey in the Dodecanese.

title: File:네이버 MY플레이스 영수증 인증 화면.png
note: Hangul and prices in 원 (won). It's a screenshot from Naver's receipt-check app, showing a Daiso haul of Disney keyrings and postcards. Wonju is in Gangwon Province, about 90 minutes east of Seoul.

title: File:Toll Receipt.jpg

answer.place: Walt Whitman Bridge toll plaza, Gloucester City, New Jersey (across from Philadelphia)

note: Short but telling: "LANE 3" and "FARE PAID" make it a toll, the date is month-first (03/07/2025), and the fare is in dollars. It's the Delaware River Port Authority's Walt Whitman Bridge, which carries I-76 between Philadelphia and New Jersey.

title: File:Grocery Store Receipt in Vienna.jpg
note: German, but the 10% VAT on food is Austrian (Germany's is 7%). The shop's name, blacked out, was Hofer: what Aldi Süd is called in Austria. This one is next to Vienna's main station.

title: File:麦当劳小票订单号39581 (202411141911).jpg
note: Simplified Chinese, so mainland China rather than Taiwan or Hong Kong, and a ¥9.90 mint-chocolate drink ordered through the McDonald's app. The restaurant is at Tianbao metro station in Dongguan, the factory city between Guangzhou and Shenzhen.

title: File:Pink Peacock receipt.jpg

answer.place: Pink Peacock café, 451 Victoria Road, Govanhill, Glasgow

note: Handwritten prices in pounds, a bagel-and-cream-cheese order, and Yiddish in Hebrew letters next to English. Pink Peacock was a queer, Yiddish, pay-what-you-can café in Govanhill, Glasgow's most diverse neighbourhood.

title: File:Чек Сільпо Чернігів 20211217.jpg
note: Ukrainian, not Russian: the letters і and ї, "ГРН" (hryvnia), 20% ПДВ and PrivatBank. Silpo prints a horoscope-style "prediction" on every receipt; this one says guests may drop by in the evening. Chernihiv is north of Kyiv, near the Belarus border.

title: File:Receipt from BCA payment terminal in South Tangerang, Indonesia (2025-08-28).jpg

answer.place: Jl. Sumatera, Villa Bintaro Indah, South Tangerang

note: "Rp." is the Indonesian rupiah, BCA is Bank Central Asia (Indonesia's biggest private bank) and "TUNAI" is Indonesian for cash. Bintaro is a suburb on the south-west edge of Jakarta.

title: File:Lidl Emsstraße receipt, Aurich (2019) 01.jpg
note: German item names, "zu zahlen" and a Maestro card payment, then the clincher: VAT at 7% and 19%, Germany's two rates. Aurich is in East Frisia, near the North Sea and the Dutch border.

title: File:Účtenka Čtyřkoly.jpg

answer.place: Penzion a restaurace U Čerta, Čtyřkoly

note: Czech: "nakládaný hermelín" is pickled Czech camembert, a classic pub snack. Prices in Kč with a euro conversion, and 21% DPH (VAT). Čtyřkoly is a village on the Sázava river, south-east of Prague.

title: File:HK Sheung Wan 喜悅海鮮酒家 Hei Yuet Seafood Restaurant Official Receipt in pink Paid chop print May-2010.jpg

answer.place: Hei Yuet Palace Restaurant, 267–275 Des Voeux Road Central, Sheung Wan

note: Traditional Chinese with English alongside (a colonial-era habit), "港幣" and "H.K. Dollars". The restaurant was in Sheung Wan, on Hong Kong Island's tram line.

title: File:Bọn Bini Supermarket receipt (2019) 01.jpg

answer.place: Bon Bini Supermarket, Jongbloedweg, Bonam, Curaçao

note: English on the till but no currency symbol, "FISCAL INVOICE" and a 6% tax (T1). The NKF/NKK fiscal numbers belong to Curaçao's tax system, and the sign-off "BO FAKTURA" (your invoice) is Papiamentu. Bon Bini means "welcome".

title: File:Paragon fiskalny - 2024.08.02.jpg
note: "Paragon fiskalny", "SUMA PLN" and VAT (PTU) at 23% and 5% are all Polish. Biedronka ("ladybird") is Poland's biggest supermarket chain. Kamienna Góra is in Lower Silesia, a few kilometres from the Czech border.

title: File:ロッテリアのレシート - panoramio.jpg

answer.place: Lotteria by Ueno Park, Taitō, Tokyo

note: Katakana and kanji (ハンバーグ, ポテトセット) and prices in the thousands of yen — Japan. "内税" is consumption tax included in the price. It's a Lotteria burger shop; the hidden header names Ueno Park, and the phone number started 03, Tokyo's area code.

title: File:CHE — GR — Region Engiadina Bassa Val Müstair — Gde. Zernez — Punt la Drossa (Munt la Schera-Tunnel · Quittung) 2024-07-18 Mattes.jpg

answer.place: Munt la Schera tunnel toll, Punt la Drossa, Zernez

note: German with an Italian line ("Termini di utilizzo"), CHF and 8.1% VAT, Switzerland's rate since 2024. It's the motorbike toll for the single-lane Munt la Schera tunnel, which leads from the Engadine into duty-free Livigno, Italy.

title: File:Albert Heijn receipt, Winschoten (2019) 08.jpg
note: Dutch shopping: aardappel, stokbrood, Brinta, vla, "SUBTOTAAL" and "TE BETALEN", paid by "PINNEN" with Maestro. The "BONUS" deals and "AH" own-brand lines are Albert Heijn, and BTW at 9% and 21% is the Dutch VAT pair. Winschoten is in Groningen province, a few kilometres from the German border.

title: File:Кассовый чек выданный при покупке в магазине DNS в России.jpg

answer.place: DNS, Vavilon mall, Kosmonavtov Ave, Rostov-on-Don

note: Cyrillic, prices in roubles (Руб) and 20% НДС (VAT), plus the paperwork of Russia's online-till law (ОФД, ФН, ИНН). DNS is a Russian electronics chain; this branch is in the Vavilon mall in Rostov-on-Don, near the Sea of Azov.

title: File:Mautstrasse Hinterriss ↔ Eng (Quittung 2020).jpeg
note: German, €3.50 and a legal citation to the "LGBl.", the state law gazette Austria uses. It's a motorbike toll for the private road from Hinterriß to the Eng, an alpine meadow in the Karwendel mountains of Tyrol that you can only reach from Germany.

title: File:Kassenbon.jpg
note: German item names (Radieschen, Bauchspeck), EUR, "Rückgeld" and "Enthaltene Mehrwertsteuer" with Germany's 7% and 19% VAT. The Edeka loyalty card (EDECARD) is German, and the company line says Nordbayern — northern Bavaria, where Schweinfurt sits on the Main.

title: File:JP 日本 Japan 京都市Kyoto 中华料理店 餃子の王将 Gyoza no Ohsho Japanese Chinese restaurant chain Receipt in June 2026 N13P 01.jpg
note: Japanese (中華そば ramen, 餃子 gyoza, 小計 subtotal) and yen. The table-and-headcount header is a Japanese restaurant check. This one is from Gyoza no Ohsho, the dumpling chain founded in Kyoto in 1967 — a pin anywhere in Kansai scores well.

title: File:Чек АТБ Чернігів.JPG
note: Ukrainian, not Russian: "ДЯКУЄМО ЗА ПОКУПКУ", "ГОТІВКА" (cash), "РЕШТА" (change) and ПДВ 20% (Ukraine's VAT); "святковою" has the Ukrainian і. ATB is Ukraine's biggest discount chain; this one is in Chernihiv, north of Kyiv near the Belarus border.

title: File:Чек платы за проезд на Западном скоростном диаметре.jpg

answer.place: Western High-Speed Diameter toll, Blagodatnaya (south) gate, Saint Petersburg

note: Russian throughout: "Номер полосы" (lane number) and "Класс транспортного средства" (vehicle class) say it's a toll. ЭКЛЗ is the fiscal memory of a Russian cash register, and "Оплата проезда по платной автомагистрали" is a toll-motorway payment. In 2011 that meant the brand-new Western High-Speed Diameter in Saint Petersburg.

title: File:LBOT cardholder copy from Caesar Park Hotel Banqiao 20191027.jpg

answer.place: Caesar Park Hotel Banqiao, by Banqiao Station, New Taipei

note: A card slip in Traditional Chinese with an English "CARDHOLDER COPY", then NT$3,600 — New Taiwan dollars. 客房櫃檯 is a hotel front desk, and the bank is the Land Bank of Taiwan. The hotel sits on top of Banqiao Station in New Taipei.

title: File:Restaurace Harmonie - účtenka 01.jpg

answer.place: Restaurace Harmonie, Lázeňská 1001 (Bertiny lázně spa), Třeboň

note: "Menu polední" (lunch menu) for 142 Kč — Czech crowns. DPH is Czech VAT, and the thank-you in Czech, German and English suits a spa town near the Austrian border: Třeboň in South Bohemia, famous for its fish ponds and peat baths.

title: File:Kaniway receipt, The Hague (2023) 02.jpg
note: A contactless V PAY card slip with "Totaal", "Kopie Kaarthouder" (cardholder copy) and "Winkel" (shop) — Dutch. The payment processor is sepay.nl. The hidden town line said 'S-GRAVENHAGE, the formal name of The Hague.

title: File:Hi-Life Keelung Qidu Store 111 receipt 20190906.jpg
note: Traditional Chinese and an electricity bill (台電 電費, Taipower) paid over a convenience-store counter — a very Taiwanese errand. The date 108/09/06 is year 108 of the Minguo calendar, used only in Taiwan (1911 + 108 = 2019). Hi-Life is one of Taiwan's big four convenience chains; this branch is in Qidu, Keelung, the rainy port north-east of Taipei.

title: File:Paragon fiskalny- 14.05.2025.jpg
note: Goździki (cloves), Coca-Cola and "PIETR. KORZ." (parsley root) by the kilo, then the Polish VAT trio PTU A 23%, B 8%, C 5%, "SUMA PLN" and "PARAGON FISKALNY". It's an Aldi in Kamienna Góra, in the Sudetes near the Czech border.

title: File:Kassenbon Grosswald Brauerei (2024-12-27) 01.jpg
note: Pils, a crate deposit ("Bierkasten") refunded and glasses — a brewery shop. Euros, "MWST. 19%", "EC-Cash" and "Wir bedanken uns für Ihren Einkauf" are all German. This is Großwald, a family brewery in Saarland, a short drive from the French border.

title: File:Taiwan Uniqlo Miramar Store receipt 2012-05-07.jpg

answer.place: Uniqlo, Miramar Entertainment Park, Zhongshan District, Taipei

note: Traditional Chinese characters rule out mainland China, and a T-shirt for $599 is New Taiwan dollars. The returns policy names "UNIQLO TAIWAN" and the company line reads 台灣優衣庫 (Taiwan Uniqlo). Miramar is the mall with the giant Ferris wheel in Taipei's Dazhi.

title: File:BRA — Rio Grande do Norte — Natal (recibo Salosino).jpg

answer.place: Salosino bar, Av. Benedito Santana, São Gonçalo do Amarante (near Natal)

note: Portuguese ("Valor Total", "Troco"), Skol and Brahma beers and a 10% "taxa de serviço", then R$ — Brazil. The NFC-e consumer invoice and the tax line ending "RN" put it in Rio Grande do Norte, the north-eastern tip of Brazil.
